verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a self-hosted AI runtime with a built-in agent platform, so event-triggered automation rules are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows on-demand agents, MCP tool connections and an approval-gated shell agent, but nothing documents user-defined rules or triggers that fire actions automatically when events occur. Startup model preloading is a configuration setting, not an event-rule system, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
